# `nlink-lab snapshot`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Save a checkpoint of a running lab (topology + runtime impairments + partitions) under `<state>/<lab>/snapshots/<name>/`.

`--list` shows the lab's snapshots, `--delete NAME` removes one.

JSON OUTPUT (with `--json`): the snapshot's metadata; with `--list` an array of them. Schema: docs/json-schemas/snapshot-list.schema.json

Usage: nlink-lab snapshot [OPTIONS] <LAB> [NAME]

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  [NAME]
          Snapshot name to create (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`)

Options:
  -d, --description <DESCRIPTION>
          Free-text description stored with the snapshot

  -l, --list
          List the lab's snapshots (newest first)

      --delete <NAME>
          Delete a snapshot

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
